title: Change a function's signature and update its callers across seven files, keeping the tests green
prompt: People keep mixing up formatMoney's currency and locale arguments. Change it to formatMoney(amount, { currency, locale }), with locale defaulting to "en-US" when it's left out, and update every caller. Callers that pass "en-US" explicitly can just drop it. The tests have to keep passing, and don't change them.
